description: Traffic census for the Queensland state-declared road network is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the National Freight Data Hub group, published by Transport and Main Roads, Qld. Traffic census for the Queensland state-declared road network showing annual average traffic counts and heavy vehicle counts. Coverage is Queensland, 2004 to 2019; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-10-24. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
